start_with: Is the installed shell pointed at the expected Rock instance?
Is demo mode active when production settings were expected, or vice versa? For Apple TV, review demo key/testing setup (Testing Your App, Demo Commands).
Is the API key valid and assigned to the app?
Does the root/start page exist?
Is the root/start page valid TVML or SceneGraph?
Does the page render anonymous, or does Lava assume `CurrentPerson` exists?
Are cache settings returning stale content?
branches.title: App Does Not Launch Or Shows Wrong Content
branches.when: App Does Not Launch Or Shows Wrong Content

start_with: Render the saved Lava output and inspect the final XML.
Confirm platform dialect: TVML for Apple TV, SceneGraph for Roku.
Check for unescaped characters in dynamic text.
Check for missing required root element. Roku should use `Rock:Page` as outer page content (Roku Pages).
Check for invalid image/media URLs.
Check device logs for parse errors.
Temporarily replace page content with a minimal valid page. If that works, reintroduce sections incrementally.
branches.title: Page Is Blank

start_with: Does the page have `Rock:Page initialFocus` pointing at an existing ID?
Are controls focusable?
Are horizontal/vertical controls wrapped in `Rock:FocusGroup`?
Is `layoutDirection` correct for the desired movement?
Are there nested groups causing focus traps?
Test with a real Roku remote.
branches.title: Roku Focus Does Not Move

start_with: Is the selectable control a Rock command-capable control such as `Rock:Button` or `Rock:ContentNode` on Roku?
Is `rockCommand` spelled correctly?
Is the command supported by that platform?
Is `rockPageGuid` a real page GUID?
If multiple commands are comma-separated, does either command fail alone?
Is the page target valid and accessible?
Is loading suppressed or hidden by a cached previous page?
branches.title: Navigation Button Does Nothing

start_with: Is the URL a direct platform-playable media URL?
Is it a YouTube URL? If so, replace it; both Apple TV and Roku docs say YouTube playback is not supported (Apple TV Media Commands, Roku Media).
Is HTTPS required by the platform or deployment?
Does the media server support range requests and correct content type?
Are captions or alternate streams supported by the target platform?
Are command attributes complete?
Are interaction/watch-map fields malformed?
branches.title: Media Does Not Play

start_with: Does the TV app have a login/authentication page configured?
Does the login command include valid login, timeout, and success page GUIDs?
Does the website authentication page exist and load publicly?
Is the Remote Authentication block on that page?
Does the block point to the correct TV app site?
Is the code expired?
Does `RemoteAuthenticationSession` show a session for the device unique identifier and code?
Does `AuthorizedPersonAliasId` get populated after the user submits the code?
branches.title: Remote Login Fails

start_with: Is page-view tracking enabled on the app?
Is retention set long enough?
Does navigation command suppress interactions?
Are media commands writing or appending to interactions?
Is the user anonymous or authenticated?
Are reports looking at the right interaction channel/component/entity?
Has cleanup removed old interactions?
branches.title: Analytics Missing

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
